rationale: Reject the proposed universal clean expectation. In jj v0.45.1, log calls workspace_helper; --ignore-working-copy disables the working-copy snapshot path, but repo loading still calls get_index_at_op. When the operation's index association is missing, or the index is corrupt/not found, get_index_at_op rebuilds the index; build_index_at_operation saves index segments and associates them with the operation. The assignment's write boundary counts repository index writes, so this reachable path is vcs_write even though it is conditional and no runtime invocation was performed here. Separately, operation-head resolution can reconcile divergent heads through a transaction. This does not claim every invocation writes: with a valid index and one operation head, these conditional paths are not taken.
